session.timestamp_assumption: CSV timestamps are interpreted in the established Cyprus workflow; the source timezone column is session label ETH, not an IANA timezone.

summary.headline: Friday book has migrated to 7640-7670; 7700 is lost overhead inventory and the deep tail is still mostly financed rather than chased.
key_points: The T3 repair structure failed: 7725-7730 pin and 7690 floor are historical rather than active.
7700 flipped intraday from put selling/synthetic-long-like risk acceptance to long-vol and synthetic-short-like protection.
7675/7650 supportive spread geometry was reversed later in the session, turning 7675 into an active protection/reclaim zone.
The freshest tactical body is 7640-7670 around a 7650 pivot.
Closing matched wings buy limited convexity below 7595 and above 7685 while the deeper tail remains capped/financed.
summary.daily_note: T4 deteriorated versus T3, but the visible tape still does not show panic-tail positioning. Near downside is protected; deeper downside is sold or capped. Friday regime resolution is acceptance above 7685-7700 versus below 7605-7595.

leave_one_out.comment: Single-trade leave-one-out is misleading: the $6.0M 4500C buy is paired at the same timestamp and size with a $5.9M 4550C sell. Removing the whole inferred vertical leaves net calls at +$2.162M.

levels.label: OLD DEFENSIVE BOUNDARY / OVERHEAD INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: Previously refreshed as an upper defensive boundary, but T4 flow is nearly balanced on puts and does not refresh it as the immediate barrier.

notes: Stateful T3->T4 downgrade: 7750 is now secondary overhead inventory.

levels.label: FAILED OLD FRIDAY PIN
levels.interpretation: The prior 7725-7730 monetization/pin zone was not refreshed after price accepted materially below it.

notes: T3 pin migrated lower on T4.

levels.label: MAJOR OVERHEAD INVENTORY / RECLAIM
levels.interpretation: The strike first attracted put selling and synthetic-long-like risk acceptance, then flipped after the breakdown into long-vol and synthetic-short-like protection. It is now an overhead reclaim level, not support.

notes: Intraday regime flip at the same strike is the strongest T4 state change.

levels.label: ACTIVE UPPER PROTECTION / REPAIR BOUNDARY
levels.interpretation: Fresh 400-lot 7685P buying makes this an active protection/reclaim area; the closing 7685C/7690C debit spread also places limited upside convexity here.

notes: 400x 7685P bought at 22:51:13 Cyprus.

levels.label: ACTIVE PROTECTION / RECLAIM
levels.interpretation: An early 7675/7650 put-credit-spread-like package was later reversed by repeated 7675P buys financed with 7650P sales, turning the zone from supportive risk acceptance into protection.

notes: 281 contracts of repeated reverse spread flow followed the earlier 227-lot supportive package.

levels.label: IMMEDIATE CALL-SUPPLY / FINANCING CAP
levels.interpretation: Late 7670C selling was used alongside 7640P buying and 7605P selling, making 7670 the upper edge of the freshest tactical corridor.

notes: 61-lot and 80-lot packages at 22:59:59 Cyprus.

levels.label: CURRENT TACTICAL PIVOT
levels.interpretation: Current spot sits inside the fresh 7640-7670 tactical inventory corridor. 7650 is the natural center of the late-session two-sided positioning.

notes: Spot ended at 7646.95.

levels.label: FRESH DOWNSIDE PROTECTION / LOWER DECISION
levels.interpretation: Late 7640P buying, including matched packages financed with 7605P and 7670C sales, makes 7640 the immediate lower decision level.

notes: Most 7640 activity arrived in the final minutes.

levels.label: SOLD TAIL / DOWNSIDE SPREAD ENDPOINT
levels.interpretation: 7605P was sold as the lower leg financing 7640P protection. The level is conditional risk acceptance, not an unconditional support.

notes: If new flow flips from put selling to put buying here, downside regime would materially worsen.

levels.label: OUTER DOWNSIDE CONVEXITY BOUNDARY
levels.interpretation: The closing 7595P/7590P debit spread buys limited downside convexity below the body while capping the tail at 7590.

notes: 127x matched closing package at 23:00:01 Cyprus.

structures.interpretation: Same-timestamp, equal-size deep-ITM call vertical-like flow. Its $11.9M gross premium should not be read as a large directional call bet near spot.
Early risk-acceptance / synthetic-long-like package at 7700. Its supportive thesis later failed as spot moved materially below the strike.
First clear same-strike downside reversal after the early supportive 7700 flow.
Matched 250x call and put buying indicates long-movement demand at the already-lost 7700 strike. An additional 100x 7700C buy printed at the same timestamp.
Repeated matched long-vol demand at 7700 confirms that the strike transitioned from support/risk acceptance into an overhead volatility center.
Late synthetic-short-like package reinforces 7700 as overhead defensive inventory rather than support.
Early supportive/risk-acceptance package above 7650. Repeated opposite-direction packages later reversed this geometry.

Aggregate of three repeated 100/94/87 contract reverse packages at 21:33, 21:35 and 21:41. The reversal is larger than the earlier 227-lot supportive spread and turns 7675 into protection/reclaim inventory.
Two matched 61-lot and 80-lot packages buy 7640/7605 downside while financing it with 7670C sales: nearby downside is protected, deep tail is sold, and rebound is capped.
Matched closing package buys capped convexity beyond both sides of the body: 7595/7590 downside and 7685/7690 upside.

monetization_zones.description: Fresh late-session inventory defines a tactical 7640-7670 body around the current 7650 pivot.
monetization_zones.caveat: This is not payoff-precise because opening/closing and complex-order linkage are unavailable.

monetization_zones.description: The final matched package pays for limited convexity outside the body on both sides, making 7595 and 7685 outer decision boundaries.
monetization_zones.caveat: The package is inferred from same-time equal-size legs; no complex-order ID is available.

beneficiaries: defensive inventory if price remains below 7700
monetization_zones.description: 7700 accumulated opposing risk-acceptance, long-vol and synthetic-short-like flow before being lost; it is now a major reclaim/exhaustion zone.
monetization_zones.caveat: A reclaim above the strike can materially change the economics of the visible downside inventory.

scenarios.name: Tactical body / monetization

triggers.description: Hold the fresh lower decision level
Remain below the late-session financing cap

invalidations: Acceptance below 7640 followed by continuation toward 7605
scenarios.interpretation: Inside 7640-7670 the freshest Friday inventory favors chop/monetization around 7650 rather than directional chasing.

scenarios.name: Bullish repair

triggers.description: Move through active protection and the upper outer-wing boundary
Reclaim the failed major inventory center

invalidations: New put protection expands while price remains below 7685
scenarios.interpretation: A move through 7685-7700 would be more than a bounce because visible 7700 support/risk-acceptance failed earlier and later became defensive inventory.

scenarios.name: Bearish continuation

triggers.description: Move through the sold tail / spread endpoint
Tail flow flips from financing/selling to outright demand

invalidations: Continued put selling around 7605-7590 with price stabilization
scenarios.interpretation: Below 7640 the next route is 7605-7595. The regime becomes materially more adverse only if the currently sold/capped tail starts being bought outright.

caveats: 94%+ of visible premium is marked Spread, while complex_order_id is unavailable.
Large deep-ITM prints can dominate raw premium without carrying comparable directional information.
